title: Warehouse peak-season failures
accepted_explanation: The new routing software is unreliable.
observations: Order volume doubles during a six-week seasonal peak.
Pick capacity rises only ten percent during the peak.
Error rates are stable while late shipments increase sharply.
Late shipments fall after temporary pickers are added.
researcher_interpretations: A demand-capacity imbalance may dominate the failure.
assumptions: Technology is the main cause because it was recently implemented.
missing_evidence: Hourly demand and effective pick capacity.
